verdict.rationale: Termius is an SSH client with a built-in AI command generator, so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it can connect to MCP servers or use their tools. The plain-language command generation feature is adjacent and does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
